messages:
Anna Chen: Heads-up — Aurora Health asking for a bespoke offer. POC -> potential enterprise. They want a 12mo commit, 200M tokens/mo baseline, and are pushing for 40% off hosted list + a $75k onboarding credit. Can we approve?
Mike Patel: 40% sounds high. Can you drop the ARR math and margin impact?
Anna Chen: Quick numbers below (rough):
```
List revenue/mo (hosted): $0.0006/token * 200,000,000 = $120,000
12mo list = $1,440,000
40% off -> $864,000 realized 
Onboarding credit = $75,000 one-time
Estimated gross margin falls ~ to mid-teens without dedicated upsell
```
Luis Gomez: @Anna thanks. From deal-desk POV we typically cap hosted discounts at 30% for this scale. Options: 1) Approve 30% + $50k onboarding credit + 60-day payment terms; or 2) 40% only if they take Dedicated pool + 12mo commit + minimum spend guarantee. Exec approval required for >35%.
Sophia Li: FYI CS — security questionnaire still outstanding. They prefer hosted but have strict PHI handling. If they require VPC/private, cost profile changes (engineering + infra). That could justify a deeper discount or a Dedicated offering.
Kevin O'Neill: Legal flag — any approval that affects data residency or brings in new T&Cs needs legal review. Also do not promise >35% without an exec OK; pricing ops flagged that in the playbook.
Anna Chen: Customer says speed to production is critical and they'd prefer hosted to avoid extra procurement. Saying dedicated risks slowing them down. They asked for a yes today.
pricing-bot: Ratecard: https://redwood.example/ratecard (shows list + committed tiers).
Luis Gomez: Given time pressure: deal desk pre-approves 30% on hosted with $50k onboarding credit and standard SLA. If they sign an annual commitment for the 200M tokens/mo baseline and agree to a 3-tier utilization clawback, we can lock it. For 40% we need exec written approval; I'll escalate now.
Mike Patel: Finance: 30% + $50k credit = acceptable margin if they hit commit. Fine from finance contingent on the utilization clauses being in the SOW.
Anna Chen: I'll draft SOW with commit table + clawback and send to Legal. @Luis please DM the execs for >35% approval; customer expects response today.
Luis Gomez: Will do. If execs don't sign off, we push the Dedicated option or move to 30% and negotiate faster onboarding. :thumbsup:
Anna Chen: Thanks — looping CS and Legal. I'll update the deal in Salesforce with the 30% approved fallback.
Sophia Li: Noted. I'll prioritize the security Q and confirm whether hosted PHI controls are sufficient.
Kevin O'Neill: Legal will review the SOW once Anna shares. Expect 24-48h for contract language changes.
Anna Chen: Copy — thanks everyone.
